set.body:
Type: implementation or qualification task
Plan: docs/institutional-pilot-epics.md
Assessment: docs/institutional-readiness-plan.md
Work key: F05.1
Accountable role (person unassigned): Frontend/integration engineer
Pilot scope: required

Scope: Add discovery APIs so users no longer need to know dataset UUIDs.
Work kind: engineering
Acceptance gate: F05 (bd-01M4W40JSS0HZY131BNTKV1QF3)

Acceptance criteria:
1. List and search accessible labs/projects/datasets with stable bounded pagination, readable labels and correct empty/error states.
2. Apply authority to names, counts, filters, ordering and suggestions; define live-directory cursor behavior under concurrent membership or catalog changes.
3. Recheck policy on later pages and omit no records silently from a purported frozen result; directory discovery must not expose unauthorized heads or private evidence.

Verification: API/PostgreSQL pagination, query-plan and hidden-data canary tests, including policy changes between pages.
Expected evidence: docs/evidence/institutional-pilot/F05.1/receipt.json
Evidence must include: exact source/artifact and configuration identity; commands or human procedure and observed outcomes; fixtures/data scope and environment; acceptance-criterion results, negative cases and limitations; reviewer/acceptance evidence when the task requires institutional input.

Starting code/evidence:
- modules/http/src/main/scala/sanctity/http/RepositoryHttp.scala
- modules/http/src/main/resources/sanctity/ui/app.js

Blocked by:
- F02.3: bd-01M4W5P591G5D5048MSJ46BN27
- F03.3: bd-01M4W5P5MCD12DVHWQC1KFXNDP

Completion rule: satisfy every acceptance criterion with observed evidence. Failed or not-run requirements stay open. Preserve scientific identity/history and current authority; create blocking remediation work for discovered scope. Automated or simulated evidence cannot replace a required institutional or human result. No implementation is claimed by this plan.
